title: Nity
tagline: Nity is a token creation tool on Starknet where users can create ERC20 tokens
description:
Nity is a token creation tool on Starknet. 
Similar to pump(dot).fun, users can create ERC20 tokens (for memes or utility) and add initial liquidity on the dapp and then launch their token publicly 

Due to technical issues, I was not able to complete the project and will continue work post-hackathon
how_its_made:
Made using Cairo as the programming language for smart contract
React/Next.js for the front-end and starknet.js for interactivity with the Starknet chain
Vercel for hosting the dapp

Due to technical issues, I was not able to complete the project and will continue work post-hackathon
